thread:
julia-sales: Quick ask from the customer's security reviewer: they want an "access controls" packet for the POC. Required: SSO/SAML attribute map + metadata, proof MFA is enforced for privileged users, example SCIM provisioning showing group-scoped sync, RBAC examples (least-privilege), and one redacted service-account rotation log. Deadline: Friday COB. Can we assemble? :clipboard:

arjun-sec: I can pull the Console > Integrations > SSO screenshot and a trimmed roles CSV. I will redact emails from logs. Do they want full permission lists or only the high-risk roles?

julia-sales: High-risk roles and a short sample matrix should be fine (org-admin, billing-admin, deployer, service-account). Also they like a one-paragraph signed attestation.

nate-ops: Service-account flow summary I can provide:
- create scoped service account (role=service-account:limited)
- issue short-lived key (TTL default 14d for infra tokens)
- key-rotator job rotates keys daily and updates secrets in Secret Manager
- rotation events and deletions logged in audit trail (I'll export a redacted slice)

claire-sol: SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 user & group sync, delta updates, and mapping rules. Admins can restrict provisioning to mapped groups only. Example mapping in Console: IdP group "eng-ml" -> Redwood role "model-deployer:execute". I'll prepare a HOWTO and a curl example.

claire-sol: SCIM PATCH example we give to reviewers:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/{groupId} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123"}]}]}'
```

arjun-sec: SAML attribute map (YAML snippet) to include for their IdP admin:
```yaml
entity_id: https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata
acs: https://redwood.example.com/saml/consume
name_id_format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
attributes:
  - name: email
    source: email
  - name: groups
    source: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group
  - name: uid
    source: user_id
```

arjun-sec: I'll attach the metadata URL and confirm the ACS endpoints.

julia-sales: MFA question: do we enforce for privileged users and how is it applied?

arjun-sec: Yes. Policy summary: interactive SSO sessions require MFA for users in privileged groups (org-admin, billing-admin). Enforcement happens at the IdP level via conditional rules; Redwood validates the session MFA flag at session start. We'll include the console toggle screenshot and a short paragraph explaining the conditional rule.

claire-sol: RBAC export: we'll include a trimmed CSV (role_id, role_name, surfaces, permissions_sample). Example rows: org-admin -> console/api/billing (elevated), billing-admin -> billing-only, model-deployer -> api/deploy. I'll flag which permissions are privileged.

arjun-sec: Separation of duties: changes to org-admin require internal approval: PR + two approvers (Security + Platform). I'll include the redacted PR checklist screenshot.

log-bot: Note: nightly audit export completed at 02:10 UTC (audit-export/2025-06-06-0210.csv).

nate-ops: Rotation evidence: I'll add a redacted audit snippet showing key creation, rotation, and deletion events (timestamps obfuscated to dates only) and the rotator Cron config (0 3 * * * key-rotator).

arjun-sec: Attestation (one-paragraph) to include in the bundle:
"Security attests that the attached artifacts (SSO metadata, SCIM mapping examples, MFA policy screenshot, RBAC export, and redacted audit logs) accurately represent Redwood Inference access controls and provisioning behavior as of 2025-06-07. For verification contact security@redwood.example.com."

julia-sales: Perfect. I'll package everything and upload to https://redwood.app/shared/sales/poc-555/evidence. Please drop final files there by Friday 18:00 UTC. I'll notify the reviewer once it's uploaded.

claire-sol: Plan: I'll produce the SCIM HOWTO + curl samples and mapping screenshots.
nate-ops: I'll export rotation log slice + rotator config.
arjun-sec: I'll add screenshots, SAML metadata, RBAC CSV, and sign the attestation.
julia-sales: Thanks all. Ping here when uploaded. :white_check_mark:
